# Vivapane

> An independent studio making Android apps. We build home screens that feel different: Aether Tiles, made of live tiles, and Hopsie, where your icons are little characters. No ads, no tracking, and your data stays on your phone.

Contact: aetherandroid75@gmail.com

## Apps

- [Aether Tiles](https://vivapane.com/aether-tiles/): Aether Tiles is a free Android home screen (launcher) that replaces icons with a grid of live tiles: clock, calendar, battery, weather, music and notifications, with no ads and no tracking. Status: Closed testing on Google Play.
- [Hopsie](https://vivapane.com/hopsie/): Hopsie is a home screen (launcher) for Android where every app is a character with eyes, arms and its usual icon. They react to your notifications, chat with each other and, on phones with built-in AI, suggest replies using the phone's own AI, offline. No ads and no analytics. Status: Coming soon to Google Play.
